response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM matched), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM matched GROUP BY transref, tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT p.*, ABS(p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pairs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), qualifying AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.avg_optvolrt, d.deviation, d.deviation - a.avg_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > a.avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM qualifying GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: Deviation means the absolute difference between a pair's average and the overall average across matched sentiment snapshots.

alternatives.interpretation: Deviation means the signed difference, with pairs qualifying when that difference exceeds their trader type's average signed difference.
